source_text: Lamina aurea in fronte: Sanctum Domino. Cogitatio in fronte consecrata. Omnis captivitas in obsequium Christi.
pass_a_gloss: Plate golden on forehead: Holy to-Lord. Thought on forehead consecrated. Every captivity into obedience of-Christ.
pass_b_english: The [[gold plate on the forehead: Holy to the Lord >> Bible:Exodus 28:36]]. Consecrate the mind’s brow. Take every thought [[captive to obey Christ >> Bible:2 Corinthians 10:5]].
